node.title: Pay maximal constant three-pencil penultimate enclosures at all normalization degrees
node.statement: For original generic-regular KoalaBear rank12/P2-rank19 sources J9965..21499, after removing paid whole-source pencil alternatives, every seven-anchor5/4 enclosure containing constant3 but no constant4 has original raw-t weight<=1048577*L_t/(67473-t), t1,2, with no normalization cap. Height-zero ordinary-child prices and48 degree bands/5238 scalar LIST steps pay root-exceptional whole-constant children using D-E. A remaining excessive parent either contains constant4 on J14965..21499, or every rank-one F-subspace has dimension<=2; in the latter case small normalization is constant-plane-only, while large normalization has image3..9 and a jump among the first7 anchors. No unrestricted rank19, whole J, row or Prize closes.
